import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Calculate age and total spending
df['Age'] = 2024 - df['Year_Birth']
df['Total_Spending'] = (df['MntWines'] + df['MntFruits'] + df['MntMeatProducts'] + 
                        df['MntFishProducts'] + df['MntSweetProducts'] + df['MntGoldProds'])

# Create figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Analysis: Demographics and Spending Behavior', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Income vs Total Spending by Education Level
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
education_order = ['Basic', '2n Cycle', 'Graduation', 'Master', 'PhD']
for edu in education_order:
    if edu in df['Education'].values:
        subset = df[df['Education'] == edu]
        ax1.scatter(subset['Income'], subset['Total_Spending'], 
                   alpha=0.5, s=30, label=edu)
ax1.set_xlabel('Income ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Spending ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Income vs Total Spending by Education Level', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Education', fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age Distribution by Marital Status
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
marital_data = [df[df['Marital_Status'] == status]['Age'].dropna() 
                for status in df['Marital_Status'].unique() if len(df[df['Marital_Status'] == status]) > 10]
marital_labels = [status for status in df['Marital_Status'].unique() 
                  if len(df[df['Marital_Status'] == status]) > 10]
bp = ax2.boxplot(marital_data, labels=marital_labels, patch_artist=True)
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], sns.color_palette('Set2', len(marital_labels))):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
ax2.set_xlabel('Marital Status', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Age (years)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Marital Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 3. Spending by Product Category
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
spending_categories = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 
                      'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
category_names = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
category_totals = [df[cat].sum() for cat in spending_categories]
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', len(category_names))
bars = ax3.bar(category_names, category_totals, color=colors, edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.2)
ax3.set_xlabel('Product Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Total Spending ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Total Spending by Product Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
            f'${height/1000:.0f}K',
            ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Customer Purchasing Channels
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df['Total_Purchases'] = (df['NumWebPurchases'] + df['NumCatalogPurchases'] + 
                         df['NumStorePurchases'] + df['NumDealsPurchases'])
channel_data = {
    'Web': df['NumWebPurchases'].sum(),
    'Catalog': df['NumCatalogPurchases'].sum(),
    'Store': df['NumStorePurchases'].sum(),
    'Deals': df['NumDealsPurchases'].sum()
}
colors_pie = sns.color_palette('pastel', len(channel_data))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(channel_data.values(), labels=channel_data.keys(), 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors_pie,
                                     textprops={'fontsize': 10, 'fontweight': 'bold'})
ax4.set_title('Distribution of Purchases by Channel', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
